topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture framing, learning outcomes, and core themes of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of tissue stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cell models, and cell-of-origin dynamics in tumor initiation across different cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external environmental exposures and chronic inflammatory microenvironments act as non-mutagenic promoters to drive tumor progression.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironments, Spatial Profiling, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how established tumors depend on stromal interactions, how these spatial relationships are experimentally profiled, and how these factors integrate into an evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Upcoming Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and outlines the topic for the subsequent lecture.
